key.name: master-enabled
key.description: Master switch. When off, every widget is removed from the panel.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which side of the panel the widgets sit in: left, center or right.

key.name: drawer-mode
key.description: manual: a button in the panel folds and unfolds the widgets, remembered per monitor. auto: collapse when the widgets would take more than drawer-space-fraction of the panel. width: collapse when the monitor is narrower than drawer-max-width. always: always collapse. never: always inline.

key.name: drawer-collapsed-per-monitor
key.summary: Remembered fold state, keyed by monitor size
key.description: Used only in manual mode. Keyed by "WIDTHxHEIGHT" of the monitor holding the panel, so docking and undocking restores the choice that was made on each screen rather than needing another click.

key.name: drawer-space-fraction
key.summary: Share of the panel the widgets may occupy
key.description: Percent. Used only when drawer-mode is auto. Measured against the widgets' own natural width, so it adapts to both the screen size and how many widgets are switched on.

key.name: drawer-max-width
key.description: Logical pixels. Used only when drawer-mode is width.

key.name: clocks
key.description: List of (label, IANA timezone) pairs, in display order. Seeded once from the machine's own timezone on first run; a static default cannot do that, hence clocks-seeded below.

key.name: clocks-seeded
key.summary: Whether the first-run clock has been added
key.description: Distinguishes "never configured" from "the user removed every clock", so an empty list is not repopulated behind their back.

key.name: weather-city
key.description: Empty means no location has been chosen yet. On first run the extension guesses one from the machine's timezone; it is never derived from the IP address.

key.name: weather-units
key.description: metric: Celsius and km/h. imperial: Fahrenheit and mph.

key.name: metrics-show
key.description: Ordered list of metric ids. Unavailable ids are ignored.

key.name: metrics-show-labels
key.summary: Use icons rather than text prefixes for metrics

key.name: metrics-disk-mount
key.summary: Mount point reported by the disk metric

key.name: remote-enabled
key.summary: Show a banner while remote desktop is enabled
